title: Settings

apiKeys.title: API Key Settings
apiKeys.description: Configure API keys for each provider. Keys are stored locally.
apiKeys.migrationHint: The Electron version uses a new secure key store. If keys from the older Tauri version appear empty, please enter them once again.
apiKeys.providerGuide: First register or sign in at {{website}}, then open {{apiKey}} to get your key.

ppio.label: PPIO API Key
ppio.help: Register on the site and get your API key from the key management page.
ppio.guide: Go to {{register}} first, then open {{keys}} to get your key.

fal.label: Fal API Key
fal.help: Get Key ID:Key Secret from the console.
fal.guide: Sign in on {{home}}, then create your key in {{console}}.

modelscope.label: ModelScope API Key
modelscope.help: Review the docs and get the access token from the token page.
modelscope.guide: Visit {{home}}, review {{docs}}, then open {{token}} to get the token.

kie.label: KIE API Key
kie.help: Get your API key from the KIE console.
kie.guide: Sign in on {{home}}, then open {{keys}} to get your key.

apimart.label: APIMart API Key
apimart.help: Get your API key from the APIMart console.
apimart.guide: Register on {{register}}, then open {{keys}} to get your key; see {{docs}} for API documentation.

bailian.label: Model Studio API Key
bailian.help: Get an API key for the China (Beijing) region from Model Studio.
bailian.guide: Open {{home}} to enable the model, then get a key from {{keys}}; see {{docs}} for API documentation.

volcengine.label: Volcengine Ark API Key
volcengine.help: Enable the model and create an API key in the Volcengine Ark console.
volcengine.guide: Open {{home}} to enable the model, then get a key from {{keys}}; see {{docs}} for API documentation.

grsai.label: Grsai API Key
grsai.help: Get your API key from the Grsai dashboard.
grsai.guide: Open {{home}} to learn more, then get a key from {{keys}}; see {{docs}} for API documentation.

providerCenter.noCredential: This provider does not currently require a key.
providerCenter.emptyProvidersHint: Add a provider to manage its key and models together.
providerCenter.emptyModelsHint: Add a model or choose another capability category.

guide.afterWebsite: to register or sign in, then open

placeholders.name: For example: My model service
placeholders.existingApiKey: Leave empty to keep the current key

hints.keyUrl: Used for the Get/Manage API Key link. No link is shown when empty.
hints.protocol: Only for unadapted custom endpoints. Presets let the SDK choose per model automatically.
hints.automaticProtocol: The SDK chooses the request protocol for each model automatically.

errors.invalidKeyUrl: The key management URL must be a valid http:// or https:// URL without embedded credentials.
errors.builtinIdentity: A built-in provider's identity cannot be changed. Disable it or reset the provider instead.
errors.inUse: This provider is still used by a prompt or assistant profile. Switch those models before deleting it.
errors.saveFailed: Save failed and the previous settings were kept. Check the fields and retry.
errors.deleteFailed: Delete failed and the previous settings were kept. Reload and retry.
errors.unknown: The operation failed. Your input is still here; check it and retry.

confirmReset: Are you sure you want to reset all settings?

general.label: General
general.title: General Settings
general.description: Configure the app's basic settings and behavior.

maxHistoryCount.label: History limit
maxHistoryCount.description: Maximum number of history records to keep

maxConcurrentTasks.label: Max concurrent tasks
maxConcurrentTasks.description: Maximum number of tasks running at the same time

interface.label: Interface
interface.title: Interface Settings
interface.description: Customize the app's appearance and interaction.

models.label: Models
models.title: Model Settings
models.description: Manage providers, keys, and all models in one place.

history.title: History
history.limitHint: Keep 1-500 items. Older records will be removed automatically.

dataPath.title: Data Directory
dataPath.pathHint: Existing data will be migrated to the new directory.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.label: Max concurrent tasks
concurrency.hint: Maximum number of tasks running at the same time (default 2, max 10).
concurrency.queueHint: Extra tasks will be queued and start when earlier tasks finish.

display.title: Display
display.priceHint: Show estimated cost in the generation panel and unify the display currency automatically or manually
display.currencyModeHint: When following language, Chinese uses CNY and English uses USD
display.exchangeRateHint: Used for converting between USD and CNY prices. Default: 1 USD ≈ 6.77 CNY
display.autoFocusHint: Focus the search box when opening the model selector

canvas.title: Canvas Behavior
canvas.autoInsertTextDisplayHint: Route new text-processing connections through one shared, editable Text Display node. Existing connections stay unchanged.
canvas.imageViewerInfoHint: Show resolution, file size and more when zooming images. Press Tab to collapse.
canvas.uploadFilenameTitleLabel: Use filename as upload node title
canvas.storyboardKeepStyleLabel: Keep storyboard style consistent with references
canvas.storyboardAutoInferEmptyFrameHint: When enabled, frames left without a description get "infer based on prior content" appended to the prompt so the model fills them in
canvas.ignoreAtTagLabel: Ignore @image tags when copying and generating
canvas.lodHint: Below the threshold, node bodies switch to lightweight skeletons and media thumbnails drop a tier to keep zooming and panning smooth. Detail-first only simplifies at very small zoom, performance-first simplifies earlier, and off always renders in full.

promptOptimization.title: Prompt Optimization
promptOptimization.label: Optimize button behavior
promptOptimization.hint: Default to showing a profile picker first to reduce accidental clicks, or switch back to immediate optimization.

download.title: Download
download.enableHint: Save downloads directly to a chosen folder
download.buttonOnlyLabel: Only use quick download for the button
download.buttonOnlyHint: Right-click downloads will still prompt for a folder
download.pathHint: All quick downloads will be saved here
download.presetPathsHint: These folders appear in the canvas node download menu for one-click saving; independent of quick download.

updates.title: Updates
updates.frequencyHint: Choose how often to check for updates
updates.clearIgnoredHint: Clearing will prompt all ignored versions again

interface.autoCollapseHint: Auto-collapse the bottom panel while browsing history
interface.collapseDelayHint: Delay before collapsing after mouse leaves
interface.uiScaleHint: Auto adjusts the interface to the available window space so smaller screens can show more complete content.
interface.startupWorkspaceHint: Open the app directly on this page, so you do not have to switch every time

assetLibrary.title: Asset Library
assetLibrary.edgeHint: Suppressed during canvas interaction and pointer dragging

theme.title: Theme Appearance
theme.description: Customize the global style with curated color tokens and live preview.

blur.label: Frosted Glass
blur.hint: Blur the backdrop when a panel sits over images, video, or the canvas. Turning it off uses solid backgrounds and lowers compositing cost.

portable.label: Theme Profile
portable.chooseModeDesc: Import the full theme, or only colors/layout tokens.

largeUpload.title: Large File Handling
largeUpload.description: When uploading local video/audio, files up to 100 MB are always copied into the data folder; larger files follow this strategy.
largeUpload.hint: Referencing skips the copy and is faster, but moving or deleting the original file will break media on the canvas.

upload.title: Generic Upload Service
upload.description: Provide file hosting for models without native uploads (e.g., ModelScope, PPIO).
upload.fallbackHint: Try other configured providers when the primary fails.

resetDataPath.title: Reset Data Directory
resetDataPath.message: Reset to the default data directory? Existing data will be migrated back.

conflict.title: Target directory already has data
conflict.message: Target: {{path}}. Choose how to proceed: merge keeps existing files, overwrite clears the target directory.

migration.title: Migrating data...
migration.hint: Please do not close the app

alias.sectionDescription: Set once per model — it applies across every provider that offers it
